newsitem.title: ITALY: Bank of Italy modifies cap adequacy requirements.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Italy modifies cap adequacy requirements.

text.p: The Bank of Italy has modified capital adequacy requirements for banks and credit institutions, in line with European Union directives, the central bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
To calculate a company's capital adequacy requirement, the Bank of Italy will now take into account consolidated data and not just the individual firm's balance sheet.

"In order to contain the impact on the organisational systems of banks and banking groups, it has been decided that the consolidated requirements will be calculated as the sum of the individual requirements for the banks and brokerages which belong to the banking group," the statement said.

To give banking groups flexibility in portfolio management, affiliates will be able to maintain individual capital adequacy ratios for debt paper of up to a third less than at group level. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
